Authenticate with the Vantor / Maxar API

Source: R/vantor_api_gettoken.R
vantor_auth.Rd

Sets or retrieves authentication credentials for the current R session. Supports both long-lived API keys (maxar-api-key) and OAuth2 Bearer tokens (Authorization: Bearer <token>) with automatic refresh when expired.

Usage

vantor_auth(
  api_key = NULL,
  username = NULL,
  password = NULL,
  token = NULL,
  refresh_token = NULL,
  verbose = getOption("vantorr.verbose", TRUE)
)

Arguments

api_key

Character string. A Vantor/Maxar API key.

username

Character string. Email address for OAuth2 authentication.

password

Character string. Password for OAuth2 authentication.

token

Character string. An existing OAuth2 access token.

refresh_token

Character string. An existing OAuth2 refresh token.

verbose

Logical. Print status messages. Defaults to getOption("vantorr.verbose", TRUE).

Value

Invisibly returns a list representing the active authentication state, or NULL if no credentials could be resolved.

Details

By default, vantor_auth() checks the following environment variables if arguments are not explicitly supplied:

  • VANTOR_API_KEY or MAXAR_API_KEY

  • VANTOR_USERNAME or MAXAR_USERNAME

  • VANTOR_PASSWORD or MAXAR_PASSWORD

Note

Authentication Scope Across Vantor Endpoints:

  • OGC & Non-Administrative APIs (get_maxar_wms_basemap(), get_maxar_wms_tiles(), vantor_get_seamlines()): Accept either an API key (maxar-api-key) or an OAuth2 Bearer token.

  • Browser-Based leaflet Tile Layers (add_vantor_basemap(), add_vantor_seamlines(), add_vantor_imagery(), vantor_wmts_url()): Require an API key (maxar_api_key URL query parameter).

  • Account Services / Admin APIs (vantor_get_usage()): Require an OAuth2 Bearer token (username and password, or token). Per the Vantor API specification, Admin APIs do not accept API keys.

Examples

# Check if credentials are configured in the environment
vantor_has_auth(verbose = FALSE)
#> [1] FALSE

# Set an API key for the current session
vantor_auth(api_key = "your_api_key_here", verbose = FALSE)

# Clear session credentials
vantor_auth_clear(verbose = FALSE)
